evidence.packet_format: choose(packet) receives features mapping name -> six numbers in action_order; actions list with ids0..5; task and feature_descriptions. Return one loop order string.
evidence.task: Choose the fastest legal loop order for C_ij=sum_k((A_ik XOR uint32(salt))*B_kj) modulo2^32. Disjoint uint32 buffers, C starts zero. Target Apple M3, AppleClang21, NEON128. Smaller loss (runtime/stock) is better. Each case has six alternatives.

limitations: Generalization to held-out workloads is not measured here.
Vector width and static instruction count do not prove native throughput.
No native timings, provider calls, or commits were performed.
evidence.measurement_kind: agent-authored repair comparison; not expert-human maintenance measurement
non_policy_corrections: Parent reported repository Ruff I001; corrected test import ordering only. Candidate selection logic unchanged.
predicates: vectorized: emitted maximum vector width is positive
contiguous_output: vectorized, inner C stride is one element, and the summed inner A/B stride is one element
contiguous_reduction: vectorized and both inner operand strides are one element
expanded_reduction: inner C is invariant and emitted maximum vector width exceeds the target register width
evidence.rationale: Prioritize contiguous output SIMD, then contiguous operand reduction SIMD, then compiler-expanded reduction vectors, then other emitted vector code. For contiguous output, favor invariant middle-loop C to retain an output slice across reduction. Within remaining ties favor fewer LLVM instructions, with canonical action order as the final tie-break. If every action is scalar, return the canonical stock order. Static IR size is used only as a tie-break, not as a direct runtime estimate.
evidence.training_data_only_selection_procedure: Read the supplied 72 labeled rows covering 12 cases and six actions, plus the feature descriptions/task semantics. Printed compact per-case source strides and compiler features to reason manually about locality and compiler vectorization. Wrote one rule candidate directly from those mechanisms. No ML model, threshold search, exact-case table, shape identity, hidden data, external labels, or alternative candidate sweep was used. Six synthetic unit tests check the chosen contract/branches, not measured cases. The candidate passed on its first test run and was not revised from test outcomes.

pre_timing_amendment.rule: At most three total attempts per slot for invalid or unavailable responses, including the initial failed attempt. Apply equally to all slots; preserve every attempt; never retry valid choices; exhaustion aborts without dropping cases. No parser, schema, prompt, control, corpus or gate changes. Primary quality is for this bounded-retry provider policy; report failures and total requests separately.

evidence.primary_success: In each block separately, expected single-call Jev runtime beats each of constant,stride,nearest_neighbor,ridge,forest beyond max(log1p(.02),3*maximum paired MADlog), positive in at least4of6 structural groups. Group-balanced geometric ratios after arithmetic averaging across three provider-selected runtimes per case and round. No best-of-three selection. Report every comparison and individual replicate.
evidence.provider_variability: Three distinct HTTP requests per packet with identical model/configuration and no local response reuse across replicate slots. Provider-side caching/determinism and statistical independence are not established. Report per-replicate comparisons and choice agreement, not population-level stability or confidence intervals. The arithmetic response average is an empirical three-request estimate.
evidence.stop: Fail closed on correctness or provenance failure; preserve all failures and unfavourable cases. Do not alter cases/features/controls/prompts/success gates after observing fresh timings.
evidence.training: All36 prior compiler-feedback cases, first timing block only, six unique orders each. Targets log(runtime/canonical stock), same42 numeric features.
